audit.summary: Two formal update comparisons have admissible counterexamples; full-rank limiting inference is invalid; separate released vision-code boundary denominators are wrong.
limitations: P1 — Theorem 3.2(4) reverses the FKLD/RKLD ordering — Counterevidence: Proof chooses sufficiently large p0, an additional condition. Correcting the printed KL direction does not fix this counterexample. Other theorem cases are not disproved.

P2 — Theorem F.3(3) has false alpha monotonicity — Counterevidence: Fixed-beta Theorem D.1 comparison survives; merely increasing underestimation ratio does not restore F.3(3), as proved by parameterized family in report AppendixA.

P3 — Full row rank does not supply uniform inverse conditioning — Counterevidence: At fixed finite stationary point full rank suffices; independent output biases or uniform smallest singular value can restore implication. Logit update identities survive.

P4 — Vision release boundary branches omit a denominator factor — Counterevidence: General branch and LLM branches match; primary ABKD Table4 parameters nonsingular; current commit not proven historical.
